IRDAI Grievance Advisory Compliance & Non-Holding Assurance

ClaimSathi operates as an independent insurance claims concierge under the Insurance Regulatory and Development Authority of India (Protection of Policyholders' Interests) Regulations. Client compensation funds are remitted directly from insurers or statutory ombudsman tribunals into the policyholder's own KYC-verified bank account. ClaimSathi holds no power of attorney over client bank mandates and never receives claim settlement sums directly. Success fee invoices are issued with valid GSTIN and 100% advance retainer offset credits.
